name: Restricted Sorcery
body:
Your magical powers manifest within a limited realm of effects.

Prerequisite: Ability to cast spells without preparation

Effect: Choose two restricted schools of magic. You can never learn or cast spells from these two schools, you cannot choose divination as a restricted school.
